title: A multi-omics approach to decipher the protective mechanism of Myristica fragrans against acute lung injury.
authors: Wang, Qin-Qin; Li, Huifang; Li, Lizhang; Yang, Shilin; Li, Zhiqiang
one_liner_zh: 该文用多组学与分子对接研究肉豆蔻抗急性肺损伤的TLR4/NF-κB通路机制，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Myristica fragrans Houtt. (Nutmeg) is used in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) to warm the middle energizer and resolve phlegm-dampness, which aligns with the TCM view of Acute Lung Injury (ALI) pathogenesis involving Lung and Spleen dysfunction. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to systematically decipher the protective effect and molecular mechanism of Myristica fragrans Houtt. (MF) against LPS-induced ALI using a multi-omics strategy. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The protective effect of MF was evaluated in an LPS-induced murine ALI model by assessing inflammatory cytokines and lung histopathology. MF's chemical profile and blood-absorbed components were identified by UHPLC-Q/TOF-MS/MS. Transcriptomics, WGCNA, network pharmacology, and molecular docking were integrated to predict core targets and pathways, which were further validated in LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages. RESULTS: MF dose-dependently alleviated ALI, reducing TNF-alpha and IL-6 levels and lung injury, with high-dose efficacy comparable to dexamethasone. Importantly, 3,4-Dimethoxycinnamic acid was first identified from MF and confirmed blood-absorbable. Twenty-four bioactive components (mainly phenolic acids and lignans) were identified in blood. Integrative analysis pinpointed TLR4 and NF-kappaB as core targets, enriched in TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling. Molecular docking confirmed their stable binding with key MF components. In vitro, MF suppressed inflammatory mediator release, downregulated iNOS/COX-2, and inhibited the TLR4/NF-kappaB pathway. CONCLUSIONS: MF protects against LPS-induced ALI by mitigating inflammation. Its bioactive components exert effects through multi-target inhibition of the TLR4/NF-kappaB pathway, providing a pharmacological basis for its potential use in ALI treatment.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：肉豆蔻（Myristica fragrans Houtt.）在中医（TCM）中用于温中化湿，这与中医对急性肺损伤（ALI）发病机制中肺脾功能失调的观点相符。研究目的：本研究旨在利用多组学策略系统阐明肉豆蔻（MF）对脂多糖（LPS）诱导的ALI的保护作用及分子机制。材料与方法：在LPS诱导的小鼠ALI模型中，通过评估炎症细胞因子和肺组织病理学评价MF的保护作用。采用UHPLC-Q/TOF-MS/MS鉴定MF的化学成分及血中吸收成分。整合转录组学、WGCNA、网络药理学和分子对接预测核心靶点及通路，并在LPS刺激的RAW264.7巨噬细胞中进一步验证。结果：MF剂量依赖性地缓解ALI，降低TNF-α和IL-6水平及肺损伤，高剂量疗效与地塞米松相当。重要的是，首次从MF中鉴定出3,4-二甲氧基肉桂酸，并确认其可被血液吸收。在血液中鉴定出24种生物活性成分（主要为酚酸和木脂素）。整合分析确定TLR4和NF-κB为核心靶点，富集于TLR4/NF-κB信号通路。分子对接证实其与MF关键成分稳定结合。体外实验中，MF抑制炎症介质释放，下调iNOS/COX-2，并抑制TLR4/NF-κB通路。结论：MF通过减轻炎症对LPS诱导的ALI发挥保护作用。其生物活性成分通过多靶点抑制TLR4/NF-κB通路发挥作用，为其在ALI治疗中的潜在应用提供了药理学基础。
